coreLoop: Heroes or characters fight automatically and continue generating useful idle or offline progression resources between active sessions.
Claim rewards, upgrade levels or skills, equip gear, and choose which hero or stat path receives the next investment.
Push a harder stage or boss with the improved roster, unlock another growth layer, and return later to collect the next idle reward cycle.

signatureSystems.name: Resource Management
signatureSystems.purpose: Manage and optimize resources to maximize idle progress and rewards.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Selecting the best resources for each hero or stat path to maximize rewards and progress.

signatureSystems.name: Game Progression
signatureSystems.purpose: Track and progress through different growth layers and stages.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Choosing the right progression path to unlock new features and rewards.

signatureSystems.name: Combat System
signatureSystems.purpose: Engage in battles with various enemies and bosses.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Selecting the best heroes and strategies to defeat enemies and bosses.

signatureSystems.name: Puzzle and Strategy
signatureSystems.purpose: Solve puzzles and strategize to progress through different levels.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Using puzzle-solving skills and strategic thinking to unlock new levels and progress.
